title: The Mislabeled Jam Jar
youtube_title: The Mislabeled Jam Jar | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A plain truth is kinder than a tidy secret.
summary: At a workshop bench of wood, glue, and labels, Paz is tangled up with a jam jar labeled peach that was really apricot and almost hides it. Paz tells Uncle Idris the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
